package v1

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
)

// RegisterRoutes registers admin/reviewer routes.
func RegisterRoutes(r chi.Router, reviewHandlers handlers.ReviewHandlers, legacyPracticeWritesEnabled bool) {
	admin := r.With(middleware.RequireRole("REVIEWER", "TEACHER", "ADMIN"))
	if reviewHandlers.ManualReview != nil {
		admin.Post("/student/task/answers/{answerID}/review", reviewHandlers.ManualReview)
	}
	if reviewHandlers.ListPendingPracticeTaskReviews != nil {
		admin.Get("/student/practice-task-reviews", reviewHandlers.ListPendingPracticeTaskReviews)
		admin.Get("/student/practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews/{reviewID}", reviewHandlers.GetPracticeTaskReview)
		if legacyPracticeWritesEnabled {
			admin.Post("/student/practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews/{reviewID}/decision", reviewHandlers.ReviewPracticeTaskSubmission)
			admin.Post("/student/practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews/{reviewID}/retry-ai", reviewHandlers.RetryPracticeTaskAIReview)
		}
	}
}
